standard_prerequisites: formal completion along a closed subset and the completion functor of the chapter
glueing of algebraic spaces along open immersions to produce pushout spaces
etale equivalence relations and the bootstrap quotient theorem
checking finite type and isomorphism conditions etale locally
core_obligations: Prove that a morphism f : X' to X of algebraic spaces, locally of finite type and etale outside the closed subset T, factors as X' to X'' to X with X'' to X locally of finite type, an isomorphism over X minus T, and X'_{/T} to X''_{/T} an isomorphism of formal completions
proof_roadmap: After adding a copy of U = X minus T to X' assume the image contains U; form the pushout R = X' amalgamated with U' x_U U' along the diagonal
Since U' to X is etale the diagonal is an open immersion, so R is an algebraic space by the glueing lemma, the two projections extend, and R is an etale equivalence relation on X'

Set X'' = X'/R, an algebraic space by the bootstrap theorem; the factorization exists, X'' to X is locally of finite type (checked on X'), and U x_X X'' to U is an isomorphism because U' to U is surjective etale and the relation restricts to the diagonal over U

The completion of R along the preimage of T equals the completion of X' along the preimage of T by construction, so the quotient sheaf description of the completion gives X''_{/T} = (X'_{/T})/(R_{/T}) = X'_{/T}
difficulty_reason: H2: a pushout-and-quotient construction; the source verifies each required property in place, the completion identification at the end being the reason the construction was set up as it was.
